notes: Keys inherited from the OAgent core: the core sends every provider's key to a signed-in device in a frame of its own (at sign-in and within a second of a change: oagent-core key, a device's key/unkey), never in the ring or a log; devices seal their copy (Keystore, DPAPI) marked 'from OAgent core' and use it offline; a revoked device deletes its copies and pairing at next contact; App.Command checks the provider's range; core 0.1.2
